WHY INDEPENDENT MATTERS

A wider lens.
A clearer choice.

An independent agent may compare multiple insurers. A captive agent generally represents one insurance company. Neither approach guarantees a lower price or a particular outcome.

How the approaches differ
ConsiderationIndependentCaptive
Insurer optionsMultiple marketsOne company
Renewal reviewMay compare marketsWithin company
CompensationMay earn commissionMay earn commission

Ask any agent about fees, appointments and compensation. No carrier partnerships are claimed by this concept.

WHEN SOMETHING HAPPENS

A little clarity in a difficult moment.

01

Make it safe.

For immediate danger, contact emergency services. Photograph damage only when safe.

02

Check your policy.

Find the carrier’s claim contact and your policy number. Ask about reporting requirements.

03

Keep a record.

Save receipts, notes and correspondence. The insurer determines coverage and settlement.
